name: team-task-manager
description: Full-stack team task manager with RBAC. Single Node service that builds the React client and serves it from Express.

scripts.install:all: npm run install:server && npm run install:client
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:client
scripts.build:all: npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
